## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if any.

## Validation

List the relevant commands and direct results, including the original regression,
negative cases, and the actual CLI/hook/installed surface exercised. Distinguish
local fixtures from authenticated host or public-package evidence. Explain any
failures, skips, or checks not run.

## Compatibility and cleanup

- [ ] Existing native IDs, settings, and ownership boundaries are preserved.
- [ ] Shipped changes include regenerated outputs and package checks where needed.
- [ ] Docs and the legacy-token scan reflect the final change.
- [ ] Temporary homes, caches, files, and processes are cleaned up or documented.
- [ ] No secrets, transcripts, local ledgers, or evidence directories are included.
- [ ] Any version or release action has separate explicit approval.

Describe remaining risks or required follow-up. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
